[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "from tiny_perceptron.natural_concepts import text_error_report
report=text_error_report('今天去臺北','今天去台北')
print('完整相同',report['exact'])
print('最少編輯次數',report['edits'])
print('參考字數',report['reference_characters'])
print('CER',report['cer'])
for a,b in [('今天去臺北','今天去臺北'),('今天去臺北','今天去北'),('A','AAAA'),('','A')]: print(repr(a),repr(b),text_error_report(a,b))"]

from pathlib import Path

print('same source users',all(next(x['user'] for x in g if x['task']=='typed_chat' and x['id']==v['id'])==next(x['user'] for x in g if x['task']=='speech_chat' and x['id']==v['id']) for v in a))"]
